context: 3 representative images sent via Telegram for progress update. Expert gave unprompted visual assessment without knowing ground truth labels.

observations.notes: Expert detected anomaly without being told which cases were erroneous. Described as 'awkward' (어색). Did not identify specific error type but correctly flagged it.

summary.notes: Expert correctly identified all 3: 2 correct as OK, 1 error as suspicious. This validates the benchmark design — error cases produce detectable anomalies for domain experts. E1 (under-converged) is detectable at 'moderate' difficulty level even in informal viewing.
